obligations.title: Objections Statement deadline

obligations.consequence_if_missed: Buyer Closing BS Differential becomes final.

obligations.title: Price adjustment true-up payment

obligations.due_date_basis: 'Objections Statement deadline' + 5 business days (weekends skipped; holidays not modeled)
